data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open menu, go to Bridges & Tunnels, open Tolls by vehicle, select vehicle class), but it adds payment method and crossing parameters and a final step that aren't in the true workflow, and it hedges on the entry point ("menu or Fares & Tolls") instead of giving the Menu -> Agencies path, so it is only moderately automatable.
